subject: Invoice routing and settlement for multi-entity renewal
messages:
From: Maya Lopez <finance@arkanehealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice routing for multi-entity subscription renewal

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off the renewal for our Redwood subscription and need to confirm how invoices and payment collection will be handled across our entities. We have three buying entities that need their own invoice rows and VAT tagging: Arkane US (EIN 12-3456789), Arkane EU (VAT GB123456789), and Arkane Labs (seat-level chargeback).

Can Redwood issue a split invoice (single PDF) with distinct remit instructions per entity and VAT handling per jurisdiction? We’ll need the following in the invoice: line-level cost center tags, the VAT amount per entity, and a remit-to instruction for our payables team.

I’ve attached a small CSV with our internal cost-center codes and suggested seat allocation. Also please confirm whether Redwood can: 1) export a machine-readable allocation file for our AP system, and 2) provide a signed amendment for the billing change (if required).

Thanks — looking to finalize before the renewal window closes on July 1.

Best,
Maya Lopez
Head of Finance, Arkane Health
finance@arkanehealth.com

Attachment: arkane_cost_centers.csv (attachment stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice routing for multi-entity subscription renewal

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear note and the CSV. We can definitely support a single PDF invoice that is split into entity sections with line-level tags and separate remit instructions. High-level next steps: 

- We’ll draft a remit matrix (CSV) matching your cost-center codes and seat allocation and return for validation.
- We’ll surface VAT calculations per entity; for EU entity we’ll show VAT line items and any reverse-charge references (if applicable).
- If you need a contractual amendment to formalize multi-entity billing, we’ll prepare an MSA amendment for signature.

Please confirm: which entity will be the invoice payor for bank transfer vs card payments? Also send the SAP/NetSuite vendor IDs if you want us to include them in the remit CSV.

I’ve attached a remit_matrix_template.csv — fill col B with your final cost-center IDs and we’ll ingest it. I’ll loop in Ben and Kim from billing to coordinate the output format for your AP.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposed allocation file and MSA amendment for Arkane renewal

Hi Maya — following up with our proposed approach. Attached is a draft allocation CSV that mirrors the template you provided; columns: invoice_line_id, sku, qty, entity, cost_center, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, remit_to. We can export this in UTF-8 CSV or JSON based on your AP ingestion.

Per VAT: for Arkane EU we’ll show VAT lines and will include your VAT registration number on the invoice. For Arkane US we’ll mark VAT as "0.00" and include a note: "No VAT applicable — US sales tax handled by Arkane." For Arkane Labs (chargeback), we’ll export seat-level rows so you can do internal chargebacks.

Please review the attached allocation file and confirm: (1) remit-to banking instructions per entity, (2) whether you want seat-level rows as separate invoice lines or combined buckets, and (3) whether we should route the final PDF to your AP mailbox (finance@arkanehealth.com) and copy your global-payables alias.

Also included a draft MSA amendment (PDF) that documents the split-invoicing model and billing responsibilities. If that looks OK we can send via DocuSign for signature — I have a link ready.

Regards,
Ben Carter
